title: Root-ready Soil Health and Market Community metadata candidate packet

sourceImagesReviewed.visualObservation: Two soil horizons with two worms; clear jar has three visible settled material layers.
Compost pile has alternating brown/green layers, heat marks rising above center and a curved turning arrow.
Same sun above two patches: bare cracked soil on left and mulched dark soil with moisture drops on right.

Open blank record grid and pencil; basket and loose vegetables are shown adjacent, and some vegetables also appear in the basket. Candidate alt text keeps the source phrase without asserting basket contents.
One farm bed branches outward to three endpoints: stall, people handing produce to a shop, and a household box.
Exactly five beds point inward to one central produce crate; hand trowel and seed jar are below it.
